title: Tens and Ones in a Number

steps.body: A two-digit number is made of tens and ones. In 46, the 4 means 4 tens and the 6 means 6 ones. The left digit counts the tens; the right digit counts the ones.

commonErrors.feedback: 46 is the whole number. The tens digit is the left one: 4 tens.
6 is the ones digit. The tens digit is the left one: 4.

widget.fallbackFeedback: The left digit of 46 is 4, so 4 tens.

explanationVariants: The right digit of 46 is 6, so 6 ones.
The ones digit is on the right: 6.

commonErrors.feedback: 4 is the tens digit. The ones digit is the right one: 6.
46 is the whole number. The ones digit is the right one: 6.

widget.fallbackFeedback: The right digit of 46 is 6, so 6 ones.

steps.body: You can build a number from its parts: 4 tens and 6 ones make 46. Put the tens count on the left and the ones count on the right.
Now build it with blocks instead of just naming it.

widget.prompt: Build 46 in standard form: rods for the tens, cubes for the ones.

commonBuilds.feedback: That builds 64 — the digits swapped jobs. In 46 the LEFT digit counts the rods: 4 tens and 6 ones.
That's only the tens — 40. The 6 still needs its cubes: 4 tens and 6 ones make 46.

widget.missFeedback: Read the digits left to right: 4 rods for the tens, then 6 cubes for the ones.
widget.successFeedback: 4 rods and 6 cubes — 46. The left digit counts tens, the right counts ones: two small digits carry the whole number between them.

predict.prompt: You'll build 46 with blocks. Which digit tells you how many RODS (tens) to grab?
predict.reveal: The left digit counts the tens: 4 rods, then 6 cubes. Swap their jobs and you'd build 64 — a different number, because place is what gives a digit its value.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents tno tens ones.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for tno tens ones must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines tno tens ones.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

steps.body: The same works for any two-digit number. In 72 there are 7 tens and 2 ones. In 30 there are 3 tens and 0 ones — the 0 means no extra ones.

commonErrors.feedback: 72 is the whole number. The tens digit is the left one: 7.
2 is the ones digit. The tens digit is the left one: 7.

widget.fallbackFeedback: The left digit of 72 is 7, so 7 tens.

explanationVariants: 5 tens on the left, 3 ones on the right: 53.
5 in the tens place and 3 in the ones place make 53.

widget.prompt: 5 tens and 3 ones make what number?

commonErrors.feedback: Don't add 5 and 3. The 5 is tens and 3 is ones: 53.
Tens go on the left: 5 tens and 3 ones make 53, not 35.

explanationVariants: The right digit of 30 is 0, so 0 ones.
30 is 3 tens and no extra ones: 0 ones.

commonErrors.feedback: 3 is the tens digit. The ones digit is the right one: 0.
30 is the whole number. Its ones digit is 0.

widget.fallbackFeedback: The right digit of 30 is 0, so 0 ones.

explanationVariants: 8 tens on the left, 1 one on the right: 81.
8 in the tens place and 1 in the ones place make 81.

widget.prompt: 8 tens and 1 one make what number?

commonErrors.feedback: Don't add 8 and 1. The 8 is tens and 1 is ones: 81.
Tens go on the left: 8 tens and 1 one make 81, not 18.

hints: The tens count goes in the left place.
The ones count goes in the right place.

steps.body: The left digit counts tens; the right digit counts ones.
takeaways: In a two-digit number, left = tens, right = ones.
Tens and ones build the number: 4 tens 6 ones = 46.
A 0 in the ones place means no extra ones.

concept.body: In a two-digit number, the left digit counts tens and the right digit counts ones. In 46: 4 tens and 6 ones. And 4 tens with 6 ones build 46.

explanationVariants: The left digit of 46 is 4, so 4 tens.

commonErrors.feedback: The tens digit is the left one: 4.
6 is the ones digit; tens is 4.
